metadata.description: forge — a curated SOTA software-development-lifecycle skill set with a live code map and a continuous-learning memory layer.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: 16 skills across the SDLC (principles, understand, brainstorm, architect, plan, tdd, debug, review, verify, ship, orchestrate, eval, design-ui, learn, graph) plus forge:recall — with hooks for automatic continuous learning, a live self-updating code-dependency map (forge:graph), and an opt-in local semantic cross-session memory + personalization layer.
